text:
Situation: Dexamethasone sodium phosphate has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2019-02-08 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 91 units of 10 mg/mL 1 mL SDV (6.3 days), 89 units of 4 mg/mL 5 mL SDV (7.8 days), and 36 units of 1 mg tablets (5.5 days). Corvale General holds multiple lots totaling approximately 800 units with 18 days on hand and can spare 165 units while retaining a two‑week supply. Transferring 165 units would raise Corvale East to roughly 12 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2019-02-08. A registered plant on our labels, EUGIA PHARMA SPECIALITIES LIMITED (FEI 3008461619), received an OAI classification letter dated 2026-09-21. That plant had prior VAI inspections ending 2016-09-16, 2018-02-20, and 2018-12-14, and two recent OAI inspections ending 2024-02-02 and 2026-02-06. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2024-08-15. Other manufacturers on the FDA shortage list include Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Mylan Institutional, and Somerset Therapeutics LLC.

Our position: Internal transfer is the only option supported by current inventory data and the rule‑ranked analysis. External purchases from listed secondary suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list and their labels do not identify a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves transfer request for 165 units from Corvale General to Corvale East.
2. Buyer executes the transfer once the director’s request is documented.
3. Buyer monitors FDA shortage page and manufacturer communications daily for allocation changes.

Not recommended: Purchasing from A‑S Medication Solutions, ASCLEMED USA INC., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, or Advanced Rx of Tennessee LLC at this time.
